about: The cab's dashboard as photographed (wwp_gecko g085-a, laid flat as 'dash'; g084-c, g083-a and g084-a registered on it as dash_g084c, dash_g083a, dash_g084a for the plate behind the steering wheel, which the wheel hides in each view): every part picked by its number on a flat (flat:n) and written into data/cabins/osa_ak.json by tools/recon/osa/panel_apply.py. Millimetres on the dashboard's plane, u right and v up from the instrument plate's centre.

measured_fit.why: g082-b's measured camera (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 44): the tachometer, coolant and oil gauges, the switch plate's two top screws and its nine switches cast onto the dash's plane fit body x = -0.0406 + 1.1988 u, v up the plane 0.02 + 1.1988 v (misses under 1 cm; the flat's 445 mm was a guess from the instruments' classes, the plate is about 534 mm); a bar not in the fit lands on the first handle's feet (u 211), and Fig. 3's antenna-lowering board (x 0.457) at 0.475. Applied to the cabin file after panel_apply; panel_apply refuses this file until it carries the fit itself

plane.x_basis: mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 puts the antenna-lowering board (ПРОХОД ПОД МОСТОМ, u 430 mm here) at x 0.457 m: the instrument plate's centre is then at x 0.027 m, and the steering wheel's hub, seen at u -385 to -440 in the views, lands at x -0.36 m as the cabin data has it (good to about 30 mm)

offsets.why: g083-a is taken from behind and right of the seats: the plate behind the wheel and what is on it stand off the instrument plate's plane, so they come out shifted in its registration. Its plaques at the plate's right edge sit 10 mm right and 5 mm low of where g084-c (taken from the driver's seat, square on) puts them; the parts only g083-a shows are moved by that much

panels.notes: The driver's half of the dashboard as photographed (wwp_gecko g085-a, g084-c, g083-a, g084-a; tools/traces/osa_interior/panels/dash.json): the plate behind the steering wheel (gauges, a square instrument with a knob, lamps, the hand lever, the waterjet flaps' switches and plaques) and the instrument plate between the seats (speedometer, coolant and oil temperature, oil pressure, tachometer, ammeter, hour counter, four lighting switches, the lamps and the central light switch). Measured on the photos laid flat, the instrument plate 445 mm wide by its instruments' classes (good to about 3 %); placed across the cab by mon_2112_80 Fig. 3's antenna-lowering board. The plane's depth, height and tilt are still SAM3D's estimate (no certified camera sees the cab).

The commander's half of the dashboard as photographed (wwp_gecko g085-a; tools/traces/osa_interior/panels/dash.json): the switch plate with nine switches (lights, heater, converter, protection, communications), БЛОКИРОВКА, ЛЮКИ ЗАКРЫТЫ and the bilge pump's switch, and the antenna-lowering board ПРОХОД ПОД МОСТОМ (voenizdat_osa_1991 p50, p99-100; mon_2112_80 Fig. 3) with its two buttons and five legend lamps; further right the DP-3B and the TA-57 as before (SAM3D estimates). Measured on the photo laid flat (the instrument plate 445 mm wide by its instruments' classes, good to about 3 %). The plane's depth, height and tilt are still SAM3D's estimate.
